about_the_game:
●Background

After a gathering with classmates, Ming sets off on a journey to Antarctica. Disaster strikes when their ship is destroyed by massive waves, leaving only a handful of survivors. With no way back, they cross the frozen polar wasteland and step beyond a towering ice wall, entering an unimaginable realm known as the Great Thousand Worlds.

Is this the end of a catastrophe, or the beginning of a legend?

◆Open World Freedom

Explore a vast open world without being bound to a single main storyline. Travel freely across the land, uncover hidden treasures, and experience unforgettable adventures at your own pace.

◆Discover a New World

Encounter diverse cultures and regions across an entirely new world. Complete over one hundred side quests to uncover its history, secrets, and inhabitants.

◆Shape Your Own Morality

Choose who you become. Walk the path of a hero or embrace the role of a villain. Your decisions shape your character and influence how the world reacts to you.

◆Choose from eight major factions, or walk the world as an independent adventurer.
Factions offer unique branches and specializations, including:

Magic Academy, featuring multiple houses such as Griffingate, Huffnpuff, Crowclaw, and Slipperyn

Holy Light Church, with heretical orders including the Dark Knight Order and the Purification Sect

Dragon and Tiger Mountain, specializing in lightning arts and talisman crafting

●Features

1.Equipment System

◆Thousands of carefully designed unique items, featuring hundreds of powerful affixes and randomized enhanced loot

◆Every equipment drop is a thrill, with chances to upgrade into refined gear or even legendary Heaven-Crafted Artifacts

◆Rune System that allows you to collect runes scattered across the world and combine them to forge powerful weapons and equipment

2.Character Progression

◆Seven-tier growth system that represents major power milestones. Each advancement lets you choose between a fast breakthrough or a perfected breakthrough, with different long-term stat bonuses and build implications

◆Technique Loadout System that allows you to learn, equip, and freely combine techniques to shape your own playstyle and progression path

◆Breathing Styles grant powerful stat bonuses and special effects while active. Mastering advanced breathing styles can dramatically boost your combat performance and survivability

◆Unlock Potentials at each progression tier to gain powerful passive abilities. Each unlock offers unique effects that strengthen and shape your character

3.Side Professions

◆Pick up side professions to support your journey. Hunt down blueprints and recipes, then craft potions, food, and gear that give you an edge in exploration and combat.

4.Life Outside Combat

◆Fishing

Fish in different regions to catch more than just fish. Pull up treasure chests, rare items, and even dangerous hidden monsters lurking beneath the water

◆Farming

Buy farmland and grow crops used for crafting and profit. Some rare plants can generate steady income over time. You can also gather wild plants directly while exploring the world

◆Housing

Purchase homes in select towns and claim a place of your own. Set up a base, store resources, and take a breather between adventures

5.Random Encounters

◆Unexpected events appear as you explore. You might run into rare beasts, powerful wandering figures, or treasure-packed monsters that can change the course of your run.

6.Packed With Side Content

◆Over one hundred side quests, hidden events, and secret treasures are scattered throughout the world. There’s always something new to discover beyond the main path.

7.Built for Replayability

◆With deep systems, flexible builds, randomized loot, and future updates, The Stupendous World 2 is built for long-term play and repeated runs.

8.Grind or Go Idle

◆Grind when you want, go idle when you need a break. Progress continues while you work, sleep, or step away. Come back anytime and collect your rewards.

9.Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Master

◆Jump in fast, then dig deeper. Master builds, optimize strategies, and push your character further as challenges grow tougher.

【Important Notice】

Before downloading or launching the game, please temporarily disable antivirus or security software. Some programs may mistakenly quarantine the launcher, which can prevent the game from starting.

If the launcher is blocked or quarantined, open your security software, restore the file to its original location, add it to the trusted or allowed list, then relaunch the game with the antivirus disabled.

If your antivirus flags the file greenworks-win32.node, please mark it as trusted or temporarily disable the software. This file is required for communication with Steam services, including achievements and DLC functionality. Other mainstream antivirus programs do not report issues with this file.

Due to the large number of items, characters, and skills, the game may take 1–3 minutes to load on first launch. Please be patient during the initial loading process.

short_description: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.
